title: Using filters
description:
Filters return only the rows that match certain conditions. They apply
to `select()`, `update()`, `delete()` and database functions that return
a table.

On `table()`, a filter is a method on a generated column constant, passed
to `where()`. The value must match the type of the column, so
`Countries.id.eq('one')` does not compile. Combine filters with `&` (and)
and `|` (or), and negate one with `not()`. Repeated `where()` calls
combine with AND. The examples use types
[generated from your database schema](/docs/guides/api/rest/generating-types).

On `from()`, each filter is a method of the query that takes the column
name as a string, such as `.eq('name', 'Albania')`.

examples.name: Applying filters
examples.description:
Filters come after `select()`, `update()`, `delete()` or a database
function call, and before [modifiers](/docs/reference/dart/using-modifiers).
examples.code:
```dart
final data = await supabase
    .table(Cities.table)
    .selectOnly([Cities.name, Cities.countryId])
    .where(Cities.name.eq('The Shire'));
```

examples.name: Combining filters
examples.description:
`&` matches rows that satisfy both filters, `|` rows that satisfy
either, and `not()` rows that don't satisfy a filter. Use parentheses
to group them.
examples.code:
```dart
final data = await supabase
    .table(Cities.table)
    .select()
    .where(
      (Cities.population.gte(1000) & Cities.population.lt(10000)) |
          Cities.name.eq('The Shire').not(),
    );
```

examples.name: Conditional filters
examples.description: A filter is a value, so you can build it up one step at a time.

examples.name: Filter by values within a JSON column
examples.description:
`jsonText()` reads a key of a JSON column as text and `jsonObject()`
reads it as JSON, to go deeper. Both filter like any other column.

data.sql:
```sql
create table
  users (
    id int8 primary key,
    name text,
    address jsonb
  );

insert into
  users (id, name, address)
values
  (1, 'Michael', '{ "postcode": 90210 }'),
  (2, 'Jane', null);
```

examples.name: Filter referenced tables
examples.description:
[`requiring()`](/docs/reference/dart/requiring) filters the rows of an
embedded table and drops the parent rows without a match.
[`embedded()`](/docs/reference/dart/embedded) takes the same filter
but keeps every parent row.
examples.code:
```dart
final data = await supabase
    .table(OrchestralSections.table)
    .selectOnly([
      OrchestralSections.name,
      OrchestralSections.instruments.select([Instruments.name]),
    ])
    .requiring(
      OrchestralSections.instruments,
      (instruments) => instruments.where(Instruments.name.eq('flute')),
    );
```

data.sql:
```sql
create table
  orchestral_sections (id int8 primary key, name text);
create table
  instruments (
    id int8 primary key,
    section_id int8 not null references orchestral_sections,
    name text
  );

insert into
  orchestral_sections (id, name)
values
  (1, 'strings'),
  (2, 'woodwinds');
insert into
  instruments (id, section_id, name)
values
  (1, 2, 'flute'),
  (2, 1, 'violin');
```

examples.name: With `from()`
examples.description: On `from()`, filters are chained and combine with AND.
